description: Read-only EVM contract call with decoded revert reason and optional gas estimate (paid) (costs 0.02 USDC on Base via x402)

block.description: Block tag (latest/safe/finalized/earliest) or hex block number; default latest

confirmNewPurchase.description: Set true only to intentionally buy an identical completed request again. Never use for retries or accepted/unclear purchases.

from.description: Optional caller address — enables gas estimation

value.description: Optional value in wei (hex 0x… or decimal string)

name: chain_call
